preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= p_i <= n for p_i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each parent index p_i must be between 0 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= c_i <= n - 1 for c_i in range(n))
preconditions.description: Each count c_i must be between 0 and n-1.

postconditions.description: If a solution exists, output 'YES' followed by n integers a_i.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a_i)
postconditions.description: All integers a_i must be between 1 and 10^9.
